question: Which species may be used for the biotechnological production of itaconic acid?

supports.quote: Aspergillus terreus is successfully used for industrial production of itaconic acid
expression of the cis-aconitate decarboxylase gene (cadA) from Aspergillus terreus converted A. niger into an itaconic acid producer

initial_executor.limitations: Aspergillus niger requires genetic modification (expression of cadA from Aspergillus terreus) to produce itaconic acid, whereas Aspergillus terreus is a natural producer used in industrial processes.
